content: For an authenticated internal dashboard with zero SEO need, Vite+React SPA is the 2026 consensus recommendation over Next.js: SSR/SSG overhead (routing conventions, server runtime, RSC complexity) buys nothing since content is never crawled, while a static SPA build is cheaper to host and simpler to develop/debug. Next.js is only justified by SEO, marketing pages, or needing server API routes -- none apply here.
